turn.message: r141 proves truthful header was sent and the current official source returned302, not401. No media was accepted because existing reader rejects all redirects; do not certify decode or assert sole cause of historical401. This is a provider-issued continuation, not an authorization denial. Add explicit server-only bounded public-IP-pinned redirect support, no TLS downgrade, no customer header/cookie forwarding, sequential close, loops/hop limits and terminal401/403. Validate synthetic security boundaries before a fresh normal redirect flow; retain existing engine and source ownership checks.
